text: Look at the mud. Footprints! All sorts of creatures have walked through here.
Whose tracks are they, Rory? Look at the toes, then tap who made them.
Little round ones with sand in them. Not a dinosaur's. And they go all the way to the nests.
Something's stealing from the dinosaurs. Come on, quietly.
Robots! Shaped like egg timers. They're stealing dinosaur eggs!
And dropping things from our time all over the valley. Tap whatever doesn't belong here, Rory, and we'll find the robot.
Got one! Upside down you go.
Upside down! Now I have to wait for my sand. I hate waiting!
Who sent you?
Doctor Hourglass. She'll be very cross. She's cross about most things.
The Sandbots dug up the nests, looking for eggs. And they've jumbled up an old fossil underneath.
Even in the age of the dinosaurs, there are fossils. Of much older dinosaurs!
Tap the stones to turn them until the skeleton is whole, Rory. Then the eggs can go back on top.
The fossil's fixed, and the eggs are back in the nest, all safe and warm. Wait. That one's wobbling.
Rory. It's hatching. Right now. In your hands.
Hello. I'm Rory. I'm not your mum.
She's decided. You're hers now. What shall we call her?
Pebble. She looks like a pebble with legs.
The Sandbots' cart went over the river, right past a sleeping T. rex.
The raft holds Rory and one more. Get everyone across, quietly, before it wakes!
Past it, with time to spare. Pebble didn't make a sound.
Clever girl. And there's the cart, full of eggs.
They're getting away with the eggs! Take the time-sled. It hovers.
Drag to steer. Catch the cart and TAG it!
Tagged! The eggs are safe. But the Sandbots jumped into a glowing hole in the air.
A time tunnel. We follow it.
Your watch has a new power, Rory. Hold SLOW and the world slows right down. Everything but you.
The Sandbots dropped their stolen things under the icicles at the cave mouth. Strange things!
They're from all through history. Put each one back in its own time, Rory.
And if one falls, I'll use SLOW.
Don't use it too long. It needs time to charge. Which is funny, if you think about it.
Our painters mark out every picture in dots first. Here's one they never finished.
Join the dots in ABC order, Rory, and see what it is. Then we'll go deeper in.
Paintings everywhere! Horses, deer, handprints. But there's a gap where the big one was.
The great horse. My great-great-great-grandmother painted it. The Sandbots took it.
The storm is coming back, and there's a hole in our snow wall.
Tap a snow block, Rory, then tap the gap where it fits. Fill it up before the wind gets in!
The wind's stopped! Everyone can stay warm.
And look. Sandbots, out on the glacier, with something rolled up like a rug.
The Sandbots are escaping over the glacier! The mammoths are faster than anything. Climb up!
Drag to steer. JUMP over the cracks and grab the sparks!
Best ride ever. Sorry, time-sled.
The Sandbots dropped the painting! It's rolled up, like a rug.
The painting goes back on the wall, but it only stays if you touch the handprints round it in the right order.
Watch the handprints glow one by one, then tap them in the same order.
It's back! Exactly where it was. The great horse.
And the present stops wobbling. Pip, how's your tea?
It's tea again! Hot and everything.
The Sandbots stole a boat and went down the river! Take my uncle's reed boat.
Drag to steer. Mind the hippos. Catch them and TAG them!
Tagged! They jumped ashore by the pyramid.
My uncle will want his boat back. It's his favourite.
The door to the pyramid is sealed with a picture lock. The signs light up one at a time.
Watch the signs, then tap them in the same order. Nefi will read them out.
It says: the stone is safe inside. Liars. It's not safe at all.
Another power, Rory. Press BACK and you jump back to where you were three seconds ago.
Somebody let the Sandbots into the tunnel and set sunbeam traps. One of the workers!
Read the clues, Rory. Which worker was it?
Got you. You've got sand on your sandals.
They paid him in sand! What a terrible thing to be paid in.
The Sandbots buried something in the sand here. Pebble can smell it!
Brush the sand away, and tap harder on rock. Don't crack what's underneath!
It's the golden capstone! They hid it in the sand.
Now it has to go up. All the way up.
The Sandbots pulled stones out of the ramp up the pyramid. The workers can't haul the capstone over a hole!
Fit the blocks into the gap, Rory. Tap a block, then tap where it goes.
Here it comes, on the workers' ropes. The capstone!
And the Sandbots at the top are running off into a tunnel.
Well done, Agent. Another moment saved.
The temple doors only stay open while someone stands on the plate. And you can't be in two places at once.
Or can you? Your watch has one more power. Echo.
Stand on the plate, then press ECHO. A copy of you replays what you did, while you walk through the door!
I held the door open for myself! That's the weirdest thing I've ever done.
Yes, Pebble. There were two of me.
The Sandbots mixed up the order of the games. The judges are all confused.
Put the pictures in order: the flame, the march, the races, and last the crowns of olive leaves.
That's right! The judges can start. All we need is the flame.
The Sandbots have the flame in a jar, on a chariot! Take ours!
Drag to steer round the track. Catch them and TAG them!
Got it! The flame's in a glass jar with an hourglass on the lid.
Doctor Hourglass signs everything. She's very proud of her work.
The flame is lit with the sun, and a curved mirror. But the mirror's been turned the wrong way.
Join up the mirrors so the sunbeam reaches the altar.
It's alight! The flame of the games!
We caught the last Sandbot! It had a note in its sand. In code.
Use the key, Rory. Each symbol is one letter. Where's Hourglass?
Upside down again. This is the worst day of my life. And I've had a lot of days. In a lot of years.
ROME. She's gone to Rome.
She likes Rome. Very punctual, the Romans.
Every arch has a mosaic sign. The Sandbots smashed one, so nobody could find where they stopped the water.
Copy the little pattern, Rory. Tap a colour, then tap the squares that need it.
The sign's mended. And look, under that arch! There's sand jammed in the channel.
And the sluice gates are shut. The water's stuck in the hills.
The Sandbots shut the sluice gates. The water's stuck behind them, up in the hills.
Open and shut the gates so the water flows all the way to the town.
It's flowing! I can hear it in the channel.
Now the town's fountains. Too much water and they burst. Too little and they dribble.
Turn the valves until every fountain is in the green.
Every fountain, just right! Dad will be so proud.
The last gate needs two levers pulled at once, and they're far apart.
Pull one, then ECHO. Your echo pulls it again while you get to the other one!
Both at once! You and... you. How does that work?
No idea. It just does.
Doctor Hourglass! She's escaping down the road in a cart with the last bottle!
Take the cart. Drag to steer, and TAG her!
Tagged? Me? Oh, you are annoying. Do you know how long it took me to get here?
Two thousand years?
Exactly! And I hate waiting. Goodbye, Agent Rory.
She's dropped the bottle! The water's free. But she's gone to the Vikings.
Hourglass left a message on the rune stones. The runes glow, one after another.
Watch the runes, then tap them in the same order to read her message.
It says: Why wait? Love, H.
She signed it. With a love. Strange woman.
Hourglass's ship left at night. We can follow her by the stars, like my grandad does.
Join the stars to draw the pictures that point the way.
She went to the island at the mouth of the fjord! Her ship's there.
The Sandbots stole our sail. Her Sandbots are guarding the boathouse. It must be in there.
I've mapped the way past their lanterns. Follow the spy map, Rory, and tap where you end up.
The sail isn't here. But there's a note: 'Look under the water, slowcoach.'
That's so rude. They threw it in the fjord!
The sail sank in pieces, down on the fjord bed. Grandad's rune path on the shore shows the divers where.
Start on the glowing stone and step on every stone just once, Rory. Then the runes light the way.
Every piece. We can sew it back together.
My mum can sew a sail in an hour. She's the fastest in the fjord.
Why wait for a sail? I'll take the whole fjord. Meet my Sand Serpent!
It's a giant snake made of sand! Bubble the glowing hourglasses on its back!
My Serpent! It's a beach now. A beach!
Give up, Hourglass.
Give up? I'm only getting started. The future's where I'm going, Agent Rory. And it's nearly ready.
She's gone forward in time. And look. She dropped a drawing. It's signed: Wren.
Sixty-six million years ago. Welcome to the age of the dinosaurs.
It's so warm. And everything is enormous!
We can hear you, Rory. The leak is strongest right where you've landed.
Those glowing sparks are bits of broken time. Grab them and we can follow the trail.
The Sandbots' cart went back into the time tunnel. The trail leads to the Ice Age.
Pebble, you can't come. It's cold there. And you're a dinosaur.
She's already on the sled. I don't think she's asking.
It's freezing! Pebble, stay close.
Who are you? And what is that?
I'm Rory. This is Pebble. She's a dinosaur.
I'm Tuva. My family paints the cave. And this morning our best painting was gone. Just gone, off the wall.
A great moment: the first painting of the great horse. Hourglass has taken it.
The horse is back on the wall! Thank you, Rory. And thank you, Pebble.
The Sandbots left something behind: a chip of gold stone. From Egypt.
Next stop, the pyramids. Four and a half thousand years ago.
Stop! Who goes there? And why is your lizard so big?
She's a dinosaur. I'm Rory. We're looking for some very small robots.
I'm Nefi. I'm learning to be a scribe. The robots came at dawn. They took the golden capstone!
The gold stone that goes on the very top of the Great Pyramid. Today's the day they put it there.
Was the day.
The capstone is on top! It shines like the sun.
The Sandbots' tunnel goes to Greece. To Olympia, and the very first games.
Pebble's getting bigger. She was up to my knee. Now she's up to my middle.
Are you here for the games? You're too late. The flame's gone out. It's never gone out.
I'm Rory. This is Pebble. We're after the robots that did it.
I'm Theo. I'm running in the boys' race. If there's a race. Without the flame, there are no games.
Hourglass has bottled the lighting of the flame. Get the moment back, and the games begin.
The flame is burning! And I came second. Second! Next time, first.
The trail goes west, to Rome. To a brand-new aqueduct.
An aqueduct is a bridge for water. The Romans built them everywhere.
Oi! Dinosaurs aren't allowed on the aqueduct. Or anywhere. I've never seen one before.
She's with me. I'm Rory.
I'm Livia. My dad built this aqueduct. Today the water was meant to reach the town for the first time. And it's dry!
Hourglass has bottled the moment the water arrives. The whole town's waiting in the square with cups.
The water's here! Listen to the fountains. Dad's crying. Happy crying.
One more tunnel. It goes north, a thousand years on. To the Vikings.
And Hourglass herself has gone through it. This time we might catch her.
A dragon! No. A very small dragon. With horns.
She's a dinosaur. Pebble. I'm Rory.
I'm Sigrid. I build ships. Our biggest longship sails for Iceland today, but her sail is gone. A woman in a coat of glass buttons took it!
That's her. Hourglass. And she's still here.
The sail is up! She's away, all the way to Iceland!
Pebble's almost as tall as me. When did that happen?
Every era, a little bit bigger. Like everybody.
Agent Rory. Thank you for coming so quickly. History is leaking.
Leaking?
Great moments are going missing. A cave painting. The top stone of the Great Pyramid. The Olympic flame. One after another.
And every time one goes, the present goes a bit wobbly. Look at my tea! It turned back into tea leaves. In the cup!
And the clock's been going backwards all day.
The one taking them is Doctor Hourglass. She's bottling history's great moments to power a machine that skips the whole world straight into the future.
Why would anyone want to skip everything?
She can't bear to wait for anything. Not even the kettle.
Which is where I come in. I'm Dr Flint, and this is my time-sled.
The leak starts a very long way back: sixty-six million years. Collect your Chrono-watch from my bench, and we'll follow it.
That's the Chrono-watch. At the moment it only tells the time.
Only?
It learns. Every few eras it'll pick up a new trick. You'll see.
Now, the time-sled. The front seat's yours.
Strapped in? Good. Pip, open the roof!
Opening the roof!
Bring history back, Agent Rory. All of it.
See you soon. Or a very long time ago.
Time-sled launching in three... two... one!
The whole of history is counting on you, Agent Rory. No pressure.
I'll be watching you on the time map. You'll be the little flashing dot.
The Chrono-watch is on my bench. Over by the blackboard.
Hop on the front seat. I'll sit behind and hold on tight.
All three golden ammonites here! Pebble is very pleased.

The egg-timer robots are Sandbots. They work for Doctor Hourglass, who hates waiting.
A baby triceratops hatched in Rory's hands. She's called Pebble, and she thinks Rory is her mum.
The Sandbots are getting away down the valley with a cart full of eggs.
The Sandbots escaped through a time tunnel. It leads to the Ice Age.

The Sandbots jumped ashore by the pyramid. Its door has a picture lock.
The picture lock says 'the stone is safe inside'. The Sandbots are after something in the pyramid.
Rory's watch can jump back three seconds. The Sandbots buried something in the sand outside.
The Sandbots buried the golden capstone. It has to go on top of the pyramid.
The Sandbots ran into a tunnel that goes to Olympia, in Ancient Greece.
Rory's watch can make an echo of him, which copies what he did.
The games are ready to start. All they need is the flame.

The flame is lit. But the Sandbots are trying to steal the olive crowns.

The water flows again, but the town's fountains are all wrong.
